meta.warning: Example activity labels and routines, not an individualized exercise prescription

records.name: Resistive exercise
records.consideration: In microgravity, specialized resistive equipment provides loading that ordinary free weights cannot provide in the same way.
records.guidance: Follow the mission-approved equipment and exercise protocol. Record completed activity and any context for review.

records.name: Cycle ergometer
records.consideration: A cycle ergometer can support cardiovascular exercise without relying on ordinary standing or walking conditions.
records.guidance: Use the approved setup and prescribed workload. Add notes about interruptions or unusual effort rather than treating a number as a diagnosis.

records.name: Restrained treadmill
records.consideration: Spaceflight treadmill exercise uses restraints and loading arrangements suited to the environment.
records.guidance: Follow the approved restraint and equipment checks. This demo does not prescribe speed, loading, or safe operating limits.

records.name: Mobility & movement
records.consideration: Movement routines need to account for the spacecraft environment, available clearances, and operational tasks.
records.guidance: Use mission-specific guidance and document what was completed. Follow mission procedures when discomfort or other concerns arise.
